h1: Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central — an IHG Chain with a 9th-Floor Rooftop Pool in the Heart of Town
intro: If you want a chain hotel where you know exactly what you're getting at an affordable price in the heart of Central Pattaya — Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central, part of IHG and opened in 2019, is the pick many people land on · A modern high-rise with 241 rooms, it has a 9th-floor rooftop pool with Pattaya city views, a 24-hour gym and buffet breakfast included in the rate · It's a 5–10 minute walk to CentralFestival and Pattaya Beach · From approx ฿1,500/night on a weekday · Score 8.4 from 823 Trip.com reviews.

body.html: Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central is an IHG chain hotel that opened in 2019 — and its main appeal is being a known quantity · As an Express brand it focuses on getting the basics right: clean rooms, comfortable beds, free Wi-Fi and breakfast in the rate, without the extra frills that push the price up · It's a modern high-rise in the heart of Central Pattaya, in the Nongprue area, with 241 rooms · Many guests choose it precisely because the chain standard means consistent quality, with nothing left to chance.

Standard rooms are around 24 sqm, done in bright, clean modern tones — with comfy beds, a pillow menu, a work desk, a flatscreen TV and a shower bathroom · Many reviews praise the bed and pillows as more comfortable than the price suggests, and room cleanliness rates well · The consistent honest note across reviews is that the bathroom and shower space are fairly compact, and the soundproofing between rooms is thin in places, so you can hear neighbours — normal for a central chain hotel where rooms aren't large.
"Headed up to the 9th-floor pool in the evening and the whole of Pattaya was right there — cool breeze, sunset, great value for the room price, and the bed really was comfortable."

The standout here is the rooftop pool on the 9th floor, looking out over the Pattaya skyline, open roughly 8:00 AM–8:00 PM · Many reviews call sunset by the pool the best moment of the stay — cool air, lovely city views · There's a 24-hour gym alongside it · What to understand is that it's a pool sized for soaking and photos rather than a big resort pool for serious swimming — which fits the concept of a central chain hotel where location and price are the stars, not resort-style facilities.

Breakfast is a buffet included in the rate — and it draws a surprising amount of praise for a hotel at this level, with plenty of variety across Thai and international dishes, good flavours and a spacious dining area · The limits some reviews mention are that vegetarian options are still few, and you may wait for a table when it's busy · Front-desk service is mostly fine, though some reviews report inconsistent staff attitude — an area the brand can still polish, but not something most guests hit.

Location is the big reason people pick this place · It sits in the heart of Central Pattaya in the Nongprue area — about a 5–10 minute walk to CentralFestival and on to Pattaya Beach · The surroundings are packed with restaurants, convenience stores and massage shops within walking distance · There's free parking, which is rare here · The trade-off is that the area is congested and busy, especially in the evening, and some stretches of pavement mean dodging the main road · Drivers will appreciate the free parking, while walkers are within reach of everything.

Honestly, Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central suits people who want a consistent chain standard, a central location and good value more than those chasing a beachfront resort or a full relaxation vibe · Rates start around ฿1,500/night on a low-season weekday, rising to ฿2,200–2,800+ at weekends and in high season (breakfast included) · With 8.4 from 823 Trip.com reviews and 4.4/5 on TripAdvisor (ranked #64 of 619 hotels in Pattaya), this is a fitting midrange pick for families, couples or travellers who want a clean, well-located room with no surprises on quality.

honestSummary: Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central is a chain hotel that suits people wanting a consistent standard, a central location and good value — rooftop pool with city views, comfy beds, breakfast included, walk to the mall and beach · Just know it's a central chain hotel: rooms aren't large and the area is busy, not a beachfront resort.
honestChecks: If you want a beachfront resort with a big pool and a full relaxation vibe — this is a central chain hotel with a modest rooftop pool, not a resort → look at Hilton Pattaya or Centara Grand Mirage instead

If you're planning a long multi-night stay with lots of in-room time — the 24 sqm standard rooms and small bathrooms feel snug → choose a larger room type or consider a serviced apartment like Somerset Pattaya
If you're a light sleeper sensitive to noise — soundproofing is thin in places and the area is busy → ask for a higher, inner-facing room and pack earplugs just in case

tips.title: Hit the 9th-floor pool at sunset
tips.body: The rooftop pool is open roughly 8:00 AM–8:00 PM. In the evening the Pattaya skyline and sunset are at their best, with a cool breeze.

tips.title: Ask for the pillow menu and a higher floor
tips.body: There's a pillow menu here — ask for what you like. A higher, inner-facing room is quieter and has better views.

tips.title: Go to breakfast outside peak hours
tips.body: The buffet breakfast is included. It's busy around 8–9 AM with table waits — go a bit earlier or later for an easier seat.

tips.title: Driving pays off — parking is free
tips.body: Parking is hard to find in Central Pattaya, but it's free here, so arriving by car is a real advantage.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central

faq.q: Where is Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central and what's nearby?
faq.a: It's at 293/16 Moo 10, Nongprue, in the heart of Central Pattaya · It's a 5–10 minute walk to CentralFestival and on to Pattaya Beach · It's about 7 minutes' drive from Terminal 21, roughly 10 minutes from Walking Street, and around 40 minutes from U-Tapao Airport (UTP) · There's free parking.

faq.q: How much does Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start around ฿1,500/night for a Standard Queen on a low-season weekday · They rise to ฿2,200–2,800+ at weekends and in high season (breakfast included) · Options include Standard Queen, Standard Twin, a city-view room and an Accessible Queen · Always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central have a pool?
faq.a: Yes — a rooftop pool on the 9th floor with Pattaya city views, open roughly 8:00 AM–8:00 PM · There's also a kids' pool and a 24-hour gym · It's a pool sized for soaking and city-view photos, and the atmosphere is best around sunset.

faq.q: Who is Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central best for?
faq.a: It's best for families, couples and travellers who want a consistent chain standard, a central location and good value · If you're after a beachfront resort with a big pool, look at Hilton Pattaya or Centara Grand Mirage instead · For a larger room on a long stay, consider Somerset Pattaya.

faq.q: What's breakfast like at Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central?
faq.a: Breakfast is a buffet included in the rate, with plenty of Thai and international variety · It draws a lot of praise in reviews for good flavours and a spacious dining area · The limits are that vegetarian options are still few, and around 8–9 AM it gets busy with table waits.

faq.q: Is Holiday Inn Express Pattaya Central noisy, and are the rooms large?
faq.a: Standard rooms are around 24 sqm and snug, with small bathrooms, best for a few nights · Soundproofing between rooms is thin in places so you may hear neighbours, and the area is congested and busy in the evening · If noise worries you, ask for a higher, inner-facing room and pack earplugs.
